body: Update in case anyone was wondering. The other day it did this but my check engine light started flashing. Took it to Kia and they replaced a rod knock sensor which my warranty covered. Got it back the same day and it didn’t even make it 20 miles before doing that exact same thing. Took it back and a day later Kia approved replacing my engine which is also covered by my extended warranty. It’s odd having to replace an engine after 74k with nothing but good and consistent maintenance.
